study type: Prospective Observational Study or Randomized Controlled Trial (RCT)
cohort: The study participants are pregnant women with intrauterine fetal demise after 20 weeks of gestation and a history of one or two previous lower segment cesarean sections.
finding: The study found significant improvements in Bishop Scores, indicating cervical ripening, particularly in the third trimester and within the 11-40 hour time groups after intervention, as well as with mechanical dilatation over 48 hours.
followup_time: Up to 48 hours (for Bishop Score improvement)
